summary: Learn to calculate Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions, reconcile data and prepare audit-ready inventories. Explore the course and request details.
lede: Corporate greenhouse-gas accounting helps sustainability, finance and procurement professionals build traceable emissions inventories. Learners practise setting organizational boundaries, calculating Scope 1 and 2 emissions, screening Scope 3 categories, and evaluating activity data and emission factors. They also work on record reconciliation, supplier data requests, and evidence documentation for recurring reporting and assurance work.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who collect, check, calculate, or report organizational greenhouse-gas emissions across operations and value chains.
prerequisites: Suggested preparation: working familiarity with organizational activity records such as energy, fuel, travel, purchasing, or supplier data. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel if you want to follow the spreadsheet exercises; no specialist software installation is required.
